pr_title: Display total commit count in hook message
pr_body:
Fixes #21379

The commits are capped by `setting.UI.FeedMaxCommitNum` so `len(commits)` is not the correct number. So this PR adds a new `TotalCommits` field.

Example of MS Teams:
![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1666336/194932364-99e3ce91-f125-42fd-8372-8adc180009f3.png)
pr_comments: Does this also fix the "X new commits" link on the Discord embed also only showing 5 commits?

Yes, all hook types show the correct commit count. But by default only 5 commits are displayed. So:

```
12 new commits:
commit1
commit2
commit3
commit4
commit5
```

My question isn't about the label. At least on Discord, the "X new commits" text is also a link to a page comparing the latest commit with the last commit before the push.

At least it should be, when I tested it, it only compared the past 5 commits in the push.

I think the url is still wrong. There are two cases.

For mirror commits the url should be correct because the commits are not used:
https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/6a6dc97b0f1d0dab7089e17abdcb194ef37f4e87/services/mirror/mirror_pull.go#L494-L499

For normal commits the url is wrong because `oldCommitID` is received from the shrinked commits list.
https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/6a6dc97b0f1d0dab7089e17abdcb194ef37f4e87/services/repository/push.go#L222-L251

This should be fixed if the shrinking takes place after the url generation.
Was the URL bug fixed before merging? Or will that be a separate PR?
I will create a different PR for that.

-->  Fix incorrect notification commit url #21479 

I have proposed one.

issue_context.title: Discord webhook maxes out at 5 commits
issue_context.body:
### Description

If you setup a Discord webhook with Gitea and push more than 5 commits, it will only show 5 commits and will only say you pushed 5 commits.

While it makes sense to truncate the amount of commits shown on the Discord embed, the issue is that the text says that only 5 commits were pushed and the the link only shows 5 commits.

(Test Repository: https://try.gitea.io/TheBrokenRail/Discord-Webhook-Bug)

### Gitea Version

1.17.2

### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site?

Yes

### Log Gist

Can't find any relevant logs for webhooks.

### Screenshots

![Screenshot from 2022-10-08 16-44-45](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17478432/194727736-3f397e36-5184-4e51-8e99-44694a722026.png)

### Git Version

2.36.2

### Operating System

Ubuntu + Docker

### How are you running Gitea?

I'm using the official Docker image.

### Database

SQLite

review_comments: That's a special character my editor warned me about.
Yeah, that was not a ASCII colon.
I changed the link text because the displayed commit ids are not the same as in `CompareURL`.
